title: Hikaru no Go
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sixth-grader Hikaru Shindo finds an old Go board haunted by Fujiwara-no-Sai, the ghost of a Heian-era Go master who longs to play the 'Divine Move'. Playing first as Sai's hands, Hikaru grows to love the game himself, chases his rival Akira Toya, and rises through the professional ranks.
life_message: It holds up dedication, rivalry and mastery of a craft as the path to growing up.

content.note: Bittersweet loss of a mentor (School Library Journal via Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy 44%).
